title: Splitting a bit string at a marked final bit
statement: Let $w$ be a finite bit string and let $a,b$ be natural numbers. If $|w|=a+b+1$ and the bit of $w$ at index $a+b$ is $1$, then $w$ is the concatenation of its first $a$ bits, the next $b$ bits, and the one-bit string $1$.
